calls.title: Every chip opens its list in one place, at one height
calls.chose: One list under the chips, as tall as the project list, for all six
calls.because: The card is centred, so a list of another height moved it under the pointer on every Tab.
passed_over: A popover anchored to each chip, as T3 draws it
calls.undo: Draw the other lists at their own height

reasons: both readings are medium under a standard posture

verdict.note: Asked in chat on 2026-11-09 with the alternative beside it; Parker chose the built option.

calls.title: Enter on a chip goes back to the sentence instead of starting
calls.chose: Enter takes the lit row and returns; Ctrl+Enter still starts from anywhere
calls.because: With the options in view, Enter reads as choose, which is what T3's pickers mean by it.
passed_over: Enter starts the agent from anywhere, as before
calls.undo: Delete one match arm in composer_key

verdict.note: Asked in chat on 2026-11-09 with the alternative beside it; Parker chose the built option.

calls.title: No project leads the project list whatever is chosen
calls.chose: Pinned first, named no project, found by its words when typing
calls.because: In a window kept on the chosen project it scrolled away whenever that project sat ninth or later.
passed_over: Leave it in the scrolling window and add a more-above count
calls.undo: Unpin it: one line in composer_project_list

calls.title: The lit row is the chip's value as the arrows move
calls.chose: Keep the composer's live choice; Esc keeps it too
calls.because: The chips already worked this way; a highlight only Enter commits adds a second undo nobody asked for.
passed_over: T3's highlight, committed only by Enter or a click
calls.undo: Separate a highlight from the value in the composer

calls.title: Each option carries the word that says what it does
calls.chose: Wire id, the model's own effort, reach flags, ssh destination, local's command
calls.because: REACH anywhere and an effort called default say nothing until you see what they add.
passed_over: Names alone, as the chips show them

calls.title: T3's Ctrl+1–9 row keys are left out of the lists
calls.chose: Typing a few letters reaches any row; no numbers on rows
calls.because: Numbers on the project list move as its window scrolls, and two keyboard routes to one row is clutter.
passed_over: Ctrl+1–9 on the first nine rows of any list, as T3 shows
calls.undo: Add the keys and their labels

reasons: both readings are medium under a standard posture
